definition: Inventories workloads, maps dependencies, selects migration approaches and groups workloads into migration waves.
Establishes accounts, identity, networking, logging, security guardrails, policies and shared services for public cloud.
Moves applications, databases, files or infrastructure to public IaaS, PaaS or SaaS environments.
Refactors or replaces applications to use managed cloud services, containers, microservices or serverless services.
Tests migrated services, performs cutover, decommissions legacy environments and optimises cost, performance and resilience.
